messages:
maria: hitting a streaming hang in python SDK when our auth token rotates mid-SSE. generator stops yielding after a fragmented event; app waits forever. repro attached below.

jun: can you paste a minimal repro + sdk version and any server-side logs? last_message_ts pls

maria: sdk==0.6.8, server is hosted. timeline: start stream -> after ~90s our KMS rotates token (internal) -> downstream gets 401, client retries auth, stream reconnects but the SSE stream had a partial event before the 401. generator yields nothing after reconnect.

maria: minimal client snippet (simplified):

```
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
gen = c.stream_chat(model='gptx-stream', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}])
for chunk in gen:
    print(chunk)
```

maria: logs show partial SSE chunks like:

```
data: {"delta":"Hel"

# connection drops, then new connection

data: {"delta":"lo"}

```

maria: after the partial `"Hel"` the generator seems to block waiting for end-of-event delimiter and never yields when the reconnect provides the rest. this looks like the SDK’s SSE parser assumes event boundaries will be preserved.

jun: do you see any 401/204 pattern? can you share server request id (x-request-id) or time window? also which transport - requests streaming or httpx?

maria: httpx 0.25.0 in our env. server headers around the time:

```
x-request-id: rwd-xyz-123
x-auth-rotate: true
status: 401 -> 200 (re-auth) -> 204 keepalive
```

maria: repro steps I used locally:
1) run simple httpx server that yields SSE in two fragments with a delay
2) inject a 401 midway and then new connection that sends the rest of the event
3) client generator yields nothing after the reconnect

jun: thanks. can you try latest python SDK (0.6.12) or set httpx stream window smaller? there was a parsing fix for split events in 0.6.11.

maria: tried 0.6.12 — still hit it intermittently. i can reproduce consistently if I split right after a unicode multi-byte boundary (partial utf-8). looks like decoder + event framing interplay.

nik: looping in eng-ml. @maria can you capture raw bytes of the responses (tcpdump or save resp.content chunks) and paste? i want to see exact byte boundaries.

maria: pasted a binary-hexdump gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/sse-split-hexdump (contains `0a0a` delimiter areas and partial utf8 bytes). gist shows a chunk ending mid-codepoint.

nik: that explains it. parser sees bytes that are valid until the split, decodes to an undecoded partial rune and waits. two potential fixes:
- make SSE parser operate on raw bytes and detect `\n\n` sequences before utf-8 decoding, then decode per-event
- or buffer and use incremental decoder to handle partial codepoints across chunks

nik: quick workaround for now — a patch that treats `data:` lines as raw and only decodes after event end. example change (conceptual):

```
# pseudocode
buffer += chunk_bytes
if b"\n\n" in buffer:
  ev, buffer = buffer.split(b"\n\n", 1)
  text = ev.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
  yield parse_event(text)
```

dev-support: escalated to eng-runtime with request id rwd-xyz-123 and attached hexdump. assigned to nik. SLA: ack in 2h.

jun: also check retry logic: if auth rotation causes 401 mid-stream we should surface an explicit exception and close generator so app can decide to reconnect rather than silently block.

maria: agreed — current behavior is hanging 'forever' which caused a customer incident (latency + billing confusion). opened billing ticket because partial tokens were counted then double-counted on reconnect.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1742, priority P2, link: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-2026-1742

nik: I’ll push a small fix to the SSE parser that buffers bytes and looks for event delimiter before decoding. will include unit test for split utf-8 sequences and auth mid-stream.

maria: thanks. can you also add a short-term mitigation we can ship to customers? some will prefer explicit errors rather than auto-reconnect.

nik: yes — adding config flag `stream.fail_on_midstream_auth` default false, set true to raise on 401. prepping PR with tests + changelog.

maria: appreciate it. tagging support case #SUP-8742 so we can update the customer.

dev-support: noted, will update customer once PR merges to main. closing loop once fix is in canary.

sre-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for canary build: build-2026-03-17-canary-018

maria: verified local patch — generator now raises an SSEParseError on this pattern. will run canary tomorrow and report back.

nik: thanks everyone. follow-up: add instrumentation to console to detect high rate of mid-stream auths (possible misconfigured token rotation).
